edits.previous: Copied results do not need an input constructor: Lean has already produced the proof-carrying value. [Nominal Java/Kotlin checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-jvm-20261013.md) add those Nat forms with JDK 22.0.2 and Kotlin 2.2.0, offline installation, relocated replay and source-free deployment of both consumers on Linux x64/glibc 2.36. [Nominal native PHP checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-php-20261013.md) add those Nat forms with PHP 8.2.33 and Composer 2.5.5, offline installation and weak/strict replay before and after relocation on Linux x64/glibc 2.36. Both source routes reproduce packages from two roots, install offline and replay after relocation on Linux x64/glibc 2.36 with Wasmtime 42.0.1.
